Gemini free limits

Gemini is used through Google AI Studio without a credit card. Limits are counted per project and per model (requests per minute and per day), and Google no longer publishes them in its documentation: the numbers that apply to you are only visible on the AI Studio limits page and can change at any time. The daily quota resets at midnight Pacific time, around 15:00-16:00 WITA.

tes_gemini.ino

Why? This code sends the question as JSON to generativelanguage.googleapis.com over HTTPS, with the key in the x-goog-api-key header. The connection is encrypted, but for simplicity the server certificate is not checked (setInsecure). That is fine for this home project; do not use this pattern for sensitive data.
The AI answer appears within a few seconds. Code 400 with API_KEY_INVALID = wrong key, 403 = key not allowed, 404 = wrong or retired model name, 429 = quota used up or too many requests.

Groq: speech to text and backup AI (optional)
The same key also becomes the backup brain: if Gemini refuses (for example the daily quota is used up), the brain code asks the GROQ_MODEL model on Groq, which can also see photos.
Your recording is sent to Groq's servers. Read their privacy policy if that matters to you. Leaving this key empty is fine too: the TALK button will not work and there is no backup AI.

Open robot_otak.ino. Fill in the CONFIGURATION section: WiFi, token, chat ID, Gemini API key, Groq API key (may be empty, but recommended as a backup), and KAMERA_ALAMAT with the camera IP from Part 4.

The robot says "Jatah AI gratis sedang habis" (free AI quota used up): the daily limit of Gemini (and Groq if filled in) has been used. Wait for the quota to reset around 15:00-16:00 WITA, or pick another model with a larger quota on the AI Studio limits page.

The bot token, Gemini API key, and Groq API key are like passwords. Do not upload them to GitHub or send them to anyone. If one leaks, delete the key in AI Studio or the Groq console and create a new one.

Example free quotas seen on one account in November 2026: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite 15 per minute and 500 per day, Gemma 4 31B 30 per minute and 14,400 per day, while Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite gets only 20 per day. The code uses Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite as the main brain and Gemma 4 31B (same key) as the first backup.

One chat with the robot = one request; a question that makes the robot take a photo is usually two (deciding to look, then describing the photo). If the Gemini quota runs out, the robot automatically switches to Gemma, then to Groq if the Groq key is filled in (Step 3). On the free tier, Google may use your questions and photos to improve its services; do not send anything private.

Open the limits page and check the daily quota of each model. The code uses gemini-3.5-flash-lite (fast, can see photos) with gemma-4-31b-it as backup. If your quotas differ, write the name of the model with the largest daily quota in MODEL (test code) and GEMINI_MODEL (brain code).
